title: Add 5 premium ultra-realistic looping electrician animations and integrate into key site sections

requirements.text: Add a new premium, ultra-realistic looping hero animation asset for the Home page showing a professional electrician in a clean blue uniform working inside a modern electrical distribution board (slow smooth hand movements, color-coded wires, precision tools, soft professional lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, seamless loop, no text, no logo).

quotes:
1️⃣ Home Page – Premium Hero Animation
Cinematic, ultra-realistic looping animation of a professional electrician in a clean blue uniform working inside a modern electrical distribution board... seamless loop, no text, no logo

acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified visual characteristics.
The animation loops seamlessly (no visible jump cut).
The asset contains no embedded text or logos.

requirements.text: Update the Home (Hero) section to use the new premium hero animation as the hero background media, replacing the current hero background GIF while preserving the existing hero overlay gradients and text legibility.

quotes: Home Page – Premium Hero Animation ... corporate electrical services style.

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section renders the new generated hero GIF from /assets/generated/ as the background media.
Overlay gradients remain in place and hero text remains readable on top of the animation.
No regressions to Hero CTAs (Get a Free Quote / Book Now / Call Us) and layout remains responsive.

requirements.text: Ensure all newly added looping animations respect reduced-motion preference by providing a non-animated fallback behavior at the component level (e.g., render a static frame/alternate still asset or suppress animated presentation when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled), without editing any immutable hook files.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled, the UI does not present motion-heavy animation for the newly integrated media (fallback behavior is applied).
No changes are made to any frontend immutablePaths files.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep all backend logic within the existing single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); no new backend canisters/services.
nonGoals: Do not implement new authentication, payments, real-time messaging, or external API integrations.
Do not change contact-form backend storage behavior or add persistence beyond existing in-memory behavior.
Do not introduce new routing frameworks (keep current single-page scroll sections).
